description: Add missing error.tsx boundaries for critical pages, fix concurrent writes on array/jsonb fields, and add API contract stability improvements
steps: 1. Create error.tsx files for the 20 most critical missing paths. Each should be a 'use client' component that catches errors and shows a user-friendly message (not raw stack traces). Use the existing pattern from app/tenant/error.tsx as a template. Create for: app/tenant/deals/[id]/error.tsx, app/tenant/deals/kanban/error.tsx, app/tenant/contacts/[id]/error.tsx, app/tenant/companies/[id]/error.tsx, app/tenant/leads/[id]/error.tsx, app/tenant/invoices/[id]/error.tsx, app/tenant/follow-ups/error.tsx, app/tenant/data-explorer/error.tsx, app/tenant/approvals/error.tsx, app/tenant/products/error.tsx, app/tenant/offers/error.tsx, app/tenant/projects/[id]/error.tsx, app/tenant/workflows/error.tsx, app/tenant/settings/api-keys/error.tsx, app/tenant/settings/webhooks/error.tsx, app/tenant/settings/backup/error.tsx, app/tenant/settings/billing/subscription/error.tsx, app/tenant/settings/admin/error.tsx, app/tenant/kb/[id]/error.tsx, app/tenant/tickets/[id]/error.tsx

2. Fix concurrent array/jsonb field writes in app/api/tenant/deals/bulk/route.ts 'tag' action. The current jsonb_set pattern (COALESCE + || append) is susceptible to lost updates when two users tag the same deal concurrently. Fix by using jsonb array append with deduplication in a single atomic SQL expression. Also fix the 'update_field' action which has the same issue.

3. Add a standardized API response envelope helper in lib/api/response-envelope.ts that all new endpoints should use: { data: T, meta?: { page, limit, total } }. Create the utility but don't refactor existing endpoints (that would be too risky). Just make it available for future use and add it to lib/api/index.ts barrel export.

4. Add a simple cron health/monitoring endpoint at app/api/system/cron-health/route.ts that reports which cron jobs have fired recently (using a module-level Map with last-run timestamps). This provides the dead-man switch / job monitoring capability. Also add a registerCronRun() helper in lib/cron/health.ts that cron routes can call.
acceptance_criteria: 20 critical pages have error.tsx files that catch errors and show user-friendly messages
Deal bulk tag operation uses atomic jsonb dedup to prevent lost concurrent writes
lib/api/response-envelope.ts exports a typed envelope helper
app/api/system/cron-health/route.ts reports last-run times for all registered crons
lib/cron/health.ts exports registerCronRun() with bounded Map storage
